Embed gives every project, directory, file, doc section and concept a
vector of its card: its path, title, summary or seed, why, and symbol
names. Search then adds a third ranked list, the entities whose cards are
nearest the query's meaning, to the two word lists (names and summaries,
and files' full text), fused by rank. Symbols and fixture files get no
vector.

The model is bge-small-en-v1.5, run on the CPU (no GPU, no server), from
the Hugging Face cache (~/.cache/huggingface/hub) or --model-dir, which
holds config.json, tokenizer.json and model.safetensors. Only entities
whose card text changed since their vector was made are embedded, so after
the first run it takes seconds. The first run over a large tree takes a
while (about 60 cards a second on 16 cores); --limit N stops after N, and
the next run goes on from there.

This agent embeds only when built with the cargo feature embed; without
it, search ranks by words alone.

Usage:
  agent index embed [flags]

Examples:
  agent index crawl
  agent index embed
  agent index embed --limit 2000

Flags:
      --bulk               Build the vector indexes after the rows instead of into them (a first pass)
      --config string      The index configuration (TOML; default: AGENT_INDEX_CONFIG, else ~/.config/gomuxai/index.toml, else built-in defaults)
      --endpoint string    Embed with this OpenAI-compatible server (a GPU's /v1/embeddings) instead of the CPU; with --model
  -h, --help               help for embed
      --json               Print the report as JSON
      --limit int          Stop after this many entities (0: all)
      --model string       Only this model's vectors (pg store; default: every model the configuration names)
      --model-dir string   The model's directory (default: the Hugging Face cache's bge-small-en-v1.5)
      --served string      The model's name on --endpoint (default: the model's)
      --store string       sqlite or pg (default: AGENT_INDEX_STORE, else [store].kind in the index configuration, else sqlite)
      --workers int        The CPU embedder's threads (0: half the logical CPUs)

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
